name: E2E Parking Dataset
description: End-to-end learning has shown great potential in autonomous parking, yet the lack of publicly available datasets limits reproducibility and benchmarking. While prior work introduced a visual-based parking model and a pipeline for data generation, training, and close-loop test, the dataset itself was not released. To bridge this gap, we create and open-source a high-quality dataset for end-to-end autonomous parking. Using the original model, we achieve an overall success rate of 85.16% with lower average position and orientation errors (0.24 meters and 0.34 degrees).
evaluation_method: task_success_rate (parking success) plus regression error for pose (position/orientation errors)
reputation: Released to enable reproducibility of an earlier end-to-end parking model; useful to that community but has modest adoption outside specialized autonomous-parking research.
notes: Dataset may be limited in diversity and scale; results reported are tied to the original model and experimental setup (closed-loop simulation/real-world conditions), which can limit generalization.
